_comment: English edition (Ireland) official resources. A hand-checked list: each URL was opened on 2026-11-15. gov.ie answered automated requests with HTTP 403, so it is not listed and no fact depends on it.

meta.title: Official resources for hospital AI decisions in Ireland
meta.description: Official sources behind this site: HIQA’s AI guidance, the Department of Health’s AI for Care strategy, HPRA’s pages for hospitals, the Data Protection Commission’s AI guidance and the EU texts.
meta.lead: This page collects the official sources behind the rest of this site, each one opened and checked.

notice: This list is not an endorsement and not complete. Pages and rules change; rely on the current text at each source.

programs.name: HIQA — AI in health and social care (press release, 29 July 2026)
programs.body: HIQA’s announcement of Ireland’s first national guidance on the responsible and safe use of AI in health and social care, with the structure of the guidance and the context of the Regulation of Artificial Intelligence Bill 2026.

programs.name: HIQA — Draft national guidance for consultation (January 2026)
programs.body: The 55-page consultation draft: principles, examples of how services and staff can uphold them, and information for people using services. It is a draft; the final text may differ.

programs.name: AI for Care 2026-2030
programs.body: The national AI strategy for healthcare: vision, six guiding principles, four strategic pillars and a roadmap to 2030.

programs.name: HPRA — Medical devices for hospitals
programs.body: How devices and IVDs are regulated, what HPRA does and does not do, and the key considerations for hospitals.
programs.audience: Clinical engineering, quality and procurement staff.

programs.name: HPRA — Reporting device safety issues
programs.body: When and how hospitals and healthcare professionals report serious incidents involving devices.

programs.name: HPRA — Managing field safety corrective actions
programs.body: A practical six-step process for notices that can include software updates.

programs.name: Data Protection Commission — AI, Large Language Models and Data Protection
programs.body: Guidance (18 July 2024) on risks and questions for organisations using AI products and for developers.

programs.name: EU AI Act — Regulation (EU) 2024/1689
programs.body: The full text of the AI Act in the Official Journal.

programs.name: GDPR — Regulation (EU) 2016/679
programs.body: The text of the General Data Protection Regulation.

programs.name: Medical Device Regulation — Regulation (EU) 2017/745
programs.body: The text of the MDR as published in 2017; check the consolidated version for later amendments.

programs.name: HIQA — news and publications (RSS)
programs.body: HIQA’s feed of news and publications; this site lists new items under HIQA news.
